summary: Multiplier on travel speed; affects arrival times and duration-based cost.
range: Number > 0 up to 5.0, two-decimal precision. Default 1. >1 = faster.
businessRules: speed_factor defines: A positive number indicating the factor by which the vehicle’s speed should be adjusted , relative to normal speed, affecting the driving durations consequently. When speed_factor is greater than 1…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.max_travel_time. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: speed_factor 2 halves travel times, easing time-window/duration feasibility.
